assets.title: Narrow-to-Wide Stream Transition
assets.description: Original S02 two-port stream-width transition over a 2 m run, with channel bank-foot spacing changing from .60 to 1.40 m. End planes X=-1 and +1; tangent X; fixed water top Z=.16 m and zero longitudinal slope. Independent water body widens from .72 to 1.52 m, with .06 m lateral bank penetration matching the original straight-scene water style. Water top edges remain on the ports, but bottom edges retreat .01 m to make slanted closed caps without overlapping bank end faces; paired bottoms have a V gap and only surface continuity is claimed. Bank relative cross-sections preserve the original .06/.20/.55 m profile with +.09 m placement offset. Independently editable bed, banks, water and four inset original faceted rocks. Bed top Z=.09 m meets bank and water bottoms without overlapping end caps; bed extends .02 m past each outer bank. Legacy earth and water PBR values retained at end surfaces. Original bend raw water width is .60 m, so exact bend-water seam and whole legacy-scene base snapping are not claimed. Static visual module only; no hydrology, collision, navigation, walkability or physics certification.
